gemma-4-e4b-q4_0.label: Gemma 4 E4B IT (QAT q4_0)
gemma-4-e4b-q4_0.note: The lighter of the two: quantisation-aware training keeps it usable at q4_0.

gemma-4-12b-q4_0.label: Gemma 4 12B IT (QAT q4_0)
gemma-4-12b-q4_0.note: Writes noticeably better captions; wants a card that is not already full of the music engine.

gemma-4-12b-q5_k_m.label: Gemma 4 12B IT (Q5_K_M)
gemma-4-12b-q5_k_m.note: More accurate than q4_0, and it wants a card with room to spare.

gemma-4-12b-q6_k.label: Gemma 4 12B IT (Q6_K)
gemma-4-12b-q6_k.note: Closer again to the full model.

gemma-4-12b-q8_0.label: Gemma 4 12B IT (Q8_0)
gemma-4-12b-q8_0.note: As close to the original as a quantisation gets. For a card that has nothing else to do.

llama-cuda-runtime@windows.label: CUDA runtime for llama.cpp
llama-cuda-runtime@windows.note: The CUDA libraries llama.cpp links against.

llama-cuda12@windows.label: llama.cpp runtime (CUDA 12.4)
llama-cuda12@windows.note: For cards and drivers CUDA 13 does not run: GTX 900 and 10, Tesla V100, drivers before 580. Needs the CUDA runtime companion below.

llama-cuda12-runtime@windows.label: CUDA 12 runtime for llama.cpp
llama-cuda12-runtime@windows.note: The CUDA 12 libraries llama.cpp links against.

llama-vulkan@windows.label: llama.cpp runtime (Vulkan)
llama-vulkan@windows.note: For AMD and Intel cards, and NVIDIA cards CUDA does not run on: the card through Vulkan.

llama-cpu@windows.label: llama.cpp runtime (CPU)
llama-cpu@windows.note: For machines without a graphics card, or for choosing the processor. Slow, but it works.

llama-cuda-runtime@linux.note: The CUDA libraries llama.cpp links against.

llama-cuda12@linux.label: llama.cpp runtime (CUDA 12.8)
llama-cuda12@linux.note: For cards and drivers CUDA 13 does not run: GTX 900 and 10, Tesla V100, drivers before 580. Needs the CUDA runtime companion below.

llama-cuda12-runtime@linux.label: CUDA 12 runtime for llama.cpp
llama-cuda12-runtime@linux.note: The CUDA 12 libraries llama.cpp links against.

llama-vulkan@linux.label: llama.cpp runtime (Vulkan)
llama-vulkan@linux.note: For AMD and Intel cards, and NVIDIA cards CUDA does not run on: the card through Vulkan.

llama-cpu@linux.label: llama.cpp runtime (CPU)
llama-cpu@linux.note: For machines without a graphics card, or for choosing the processor. Slow, but it works.

llama-cpu@macos.label: llama.cpp runtime (Metal)
llama-cpu@macos.note: Runs on the Mac's own graphics through Metal, in the memory it shares with the processor.

engine-cuda-cublas.label: NVIDIA cuBLAS 13.5
engine-cuda-cublas.note: The linear algebra the engine's CUDA backend is linked against. Without it the engine cannot start at all.

engine-cuda12-cublas.label: NVIDIA cuBLAS 12.9
engine-cuda12-cublas.note: The linear algebra of the engine's CUDA 12 backend, for cards CUDA 13 dropped and older drivers.

engine-cuda-cudart-linux.label: NVIDIA CUDA runtime 13.4
engine-cuda-cudart-linux.note: The CUDA runtime of the engine's CUDA 13 backend and of the audio.cpp server.

engine-cuda-cublas-linux.label: NVIDIA cuBLAS 13.8
engine-cuda-cublas-linux.note: The linear algebra of the engine's CUDA 13 backend and of the audio.cpp server.

engine-cuda12-cudart-linux.label: NVIDIA CUDA runtime 12.9
engine-cuda12-cudart-linux.note: The CUDA runtime of the engine's CUDA 12 backend and of the audio.cpp server.

engine-cuda12-cublas-linux.label: NVIDIA cuBLAS 12.9
engine-cuda12-cublas-linux.note: The linear algebra of the engine's CUDA 12 backend and of the audio.cpp server.

crisperwhisper-turbo.label: CrisperWhisper 2.0 turbo
crisperwhisper-turbo.note: Whisper large-v3 turbo trained for verbatim word timings, in audio.cpp: what karaoke and the dataset lyrics are heard with.

parakeet-tdt-int8.label: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 (Q8_0)
parakeet-tdt-int8.note: NVIDIA's recogniser, the one Dub Studio uses: 25 European languages, the time of each word.

parakeet-ultra-int8.label: Parakeet Ultra 0.6B (Q8_0)
parakeet-ultra-int8.note: Moondream's post-trained Parakeet v3: fewer wrong words in Russian and in noise.

onnxruntime@windows.label: ONNX Runtime 1.32.0
onnxruntime@windows.note: The tempo model runs on this, on the processor; it is loaded at run time, not linked in.

onnxruntime@linux.label: ONNX Runtime 1.32.0
onnxruntime@linux.note: The tempo model runs on this, on the processor; it is loaded at run time, not linked in.

onnxruntime@macos.label: ONNX Runtime 1.32.0
onnxruntime@macos.note: The tempo model runs on this, on the processor; it is loaded at run time, not linked in.

htdemucs-6s.label: HT-Demucs 6 stems
htdemucs-6s.note: Six stems: drums, bass, other, vocals, guitar, piano. MIT-licensed, runs on audio.cpp's server.

roformer.label: Mel-Band RoFormer voc_fv6 (Q8_0)
roformer.note: The vocals and the rest, cleaner than HT-Demucs: Dub Studio's separator, run by BSRoformer.cpp.

apollo.label: Apollo
apollo.note: Restores music compressed to MP3: removes the artefacts of compression, 44.1 kHz, the channels kept. Apollo (JusperLee), weights CC BY-SA 4.0, runs on audio.cpp's server.

rvc-f16.label: RVC F16 GGUF
rvc-f16.note: Native RVC voice conversion support weights for audio.cpp.
